# Greenance

> AI-powered nature risk intelligence platform (water, soil, biodiversity) at the asset level, primarly for banks, but also asset managers, insurers, and any financial institutions.

Greenance automatically identifies and geolocates a company's assets from its name alone, covering a portfolio of 150+ assets in a few minutes. Each site is cross-referenced against global environmental databases (WRI Aqueduct, SoilGrids, Natura 2000, IBAT, Natura 2000, KBA, Copernicus, USGS, GRESB, Open-Meteo) to produce a nature vulnerability score, tailored to the activity, across three pillars: water, soil, biodiversity.

The methodology is built on the TNFD/LEAP and ENCORE frameworks, and aligns with CSRD and ECB/SSM supervisory expectations on physical risk (2026), as well as EBA/GL/2025/01.

Built first for commercial banks (credit analysts, ESG teams, risk and compliance directors), Greenance also serves asset managers, insurers, SCPI/OPCI managers, and development banks.

## Research
- [Baromètre 2026 : la place pour les risques liés à la nature dans l'analyse crédit](https://greenance.fr/barometre-2026-risques-nature-analyse-credit.html): exploratory survey by Greenance × Junior ESSEC of 81 professionals (banking, other financial activities, consulting), July-October 2026, on reported practices, tools, obstacles and expected formats for nature-related risks in credit analysis. Non-probability sample; figures describe respondents, not banks. Full report, summary and key figures (PowerPoint, PDF) are free to download, in French.
